noun_definition: Message refers to the content sent in a chat that can be edited, specifically highlighting the issue of how emojis appear when the message is in edit mode.
Emoji refers to a graphical symbol sent in a chat that appears larger than normal when sent alone, which the user expects to be fully visible in the Edit message mode.
Edit message mode refers to the state in the New Expensify App where a user can modify a previously sent message, specifically accessed by selecting the "Edit Message" option after sending an emoji.
